DIAGNOSIS READY: Inflammatory Bowel Disease (Ulcerative Colitis or Crohn's Disease)

The combination of chronic diarrhea, pain relieved by defecation, elevated inflammatory markers (CRP, Fecal Calprotectin), and systemic symptoms like joint pain or rash strongly suggests an inflammatory bowel disease rather than an infectious or functional cause. The imaging and colonoscopy results would typically confirm mucosal inflammation, ulceration, or skip lesions to distinguish between Crohn's and Ulcerative Colitis.
